title: Lock-Free Height-Balanced Allocation: Parallel Memory Management in Chronos-Allocator for C++ and Rust

abstract: Parallel allocation in shared-memory systems must reconcile low contention with strict safety guarantees. We present a lock-free height-balanced allocator built atop a balanced search tree that preserves a strict height-balance invariant while enabling concurrent allocation and deallocation. The allocator's design is formally verified to maintain the key-ordered and height-balanced properties, yielding $O(\log N)$ amortized allocation and deallocation times. Static abstract syntax tree inspection confirms that the implementation satisfies the theoretical bounds and that the code footprint remains compact. No empirical wall-clock measurements are reported; the analysis is purely structural. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/cpp-systems-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261125_170211_parallel_memory_management_in}
